segments.text: WARNING: Don't judge the Tata Nexon by its price tag! The base model might just surprise you
Under the hood, it's rocking an 81 kW engine - pretty impressive for a 1.5-litre vehicle
And when you need some extra oomph, the 245 N⋅m of torque has got your back
But here's the sweet spot: the Creative variant, loaded with goodies like a 360-degree camera, automatic climate control, alloy wheels, and cruise control
So, can the Nexon go from 0 to 'I'm having way too much fun' in under 9.9 seconds? You bet it can!
Nexon vs Brezza: which team are you on? Let us know in the comments, and don't forget to like, share, and subscribe for more!
